name: Nova Pulse 5G
description: Nova Pulse 5G is a balanced ₹19,999 smartphone tailored for Indian college students, featuring a 120Hz Super AMOLED display, 5000mAh battery with 45W fast charging, 64MP OIS camera, and clean ad-free Pulse UI.
target_group: Indian college students and young job seekers

features.name: Dimensity 7050 5G Processor
features.explanation: Efficient 6nm octa-core processor ensuring lag-free multitasking, social media feeds, and gaming.

features.name: 120Hz Super AMOLED Display
features.explanation: 6.67-inch FHD+ screen with vibrant colors, HDR10+, and 120Hz refresh rate for smooth scrolling.

features.name: 5000mAh Battery + 45W Fast Charge
features.explanation: All-day endurance easily lasting 7+ hours of screen time with 50% charge in 25 minutes.

features.name: 64MP OIS Primary Camera
features.explanation: Optical Image Stabilization for steady videos and sharp low-light pictures during college festivals and trips.

features.name: Smart Privacy Shield
features.explanation: Private safe for sensitive photos and documents, with granular camera and mic access indicators.

features.name: Clean Pulse UI (Android 14)
features.explanation: Streamlined, clutter-free software experience with zero lock-screen advertisements and 2 guaranteed OS upgrades.
